from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any


@dataclass

    order_id: str

enum class ProductStatus { ACTIVE, DISCONTINUED, DRAFT }

data class Product(
    val sku: String,
    val firstName: String,
    val lastName: String,
    val priceCents: Double,
    val status: ProductStatus,
    val created: Double,
    val stock: String,
    val discount: Double? = null,
)

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum


class ProductStatus(str, Enum):
    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
    DISCONTINUED = "DISCONTINUED"
    DRAFT = "DRAFT"


@dataclass
class Product:
    sku: str
    first_name: str
    last_name: str
    price_cents: float
    status: ProductStatus
    created: float
    stock: str
    discount: float | None = None

export enum ProductStatus {
  Active = "ACTIVE",
  Discontinued = "DISCONTINUED",
  Draft = "DRAFT",
}

export interface Product {
  sku: string
  firstName: string
  lastName: string
  priceCents: number
  status: ProductStatus
  created: number
  stock: string
  discount: number | null
}

data class Customer(
    val id: Long? = null,
    val name: String,
    val email: String,
)

data class Address(
    val street: String,
    val city: String,
    val zipCode: String,
    val country: String,
)

data class Order(
    val id: Long? = null,
    val customer: Customer,
    val shipping: Address,
    val status: String,
)
